senses.gloss: to part, go away. Y. Ber. I, 2ᵈ bot. ומצאו שה׳ אף הוא ה׳ (not עוד) and finding that he (the friend that had knocked at the door) had withdrawn, he withdrew likewise.—Esp. to go to sea (cmp. פִּילָגוֹס).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 4:1">Erub. IV, 1</cite> <he>הִפְלִיגָה ספינתם בים</he> their ship went out on the open sea.

<cite ref="Shabbat 19a:8">Sabb. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>אין מַפְלִיגִין בספינה וכ׳</he> you must not start on a sea-voyage less than three days before the Sabbath; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 16">Num. R. s. 16</cite>, beg. <he>אין מפליגין בספינה בים הגדול</he> (contrad. to <cite ref="Q02021"><he>פָּרַשׁ</he></cite> along the sea coast).

senses.gloss: ה׳ ממלאכה (or sub. ממלאכה) to rest from work; to pause.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30:3">Lev. R. s. 30</cite> <he>לכשיַפְלִיג</he>, v. <cite ref="L00700"><he>לָקַשׁ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 4:21">Tosef. Ber. IV, 21</cite> <he>הִפְלִיגוּ צריכין וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="R00773"><he>צריך</he></cite>) when the laborers take a recess, they must say the benediction for what they have been eating while at work. Y. Yoma III, 40ᵇ bot. <he>להפליג</he>, v. <cite ref="E00749"><he>הֶפְלֵג</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to divert, put off; to discard. Bab. ib. 66ᵇ לא מפני שהִפְלִיגָן בדברים וכ׳ (he made an evasive reply) not because he desired to divert their minds with words (counterquestions), but because he never said anything that he had not heard from his teacher; Tosef. Yeb. III, 4; Succ. 27ᵇ. Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40ᶜ bot. אם שאלו … יַפְלִיגֶינּוּ כשם שה׳ וכ׳ if he asks him whither he is going, let him put him off (state a distant destination), as did Jacob to Esau; Tosef. Ab. Zar. III, 4 מַפְלִיגוֹ.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Gittin 7:8">Tosef. Gitt. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Gittin 5:8">V</cite>), 8 <he>כל תנאי שאי אפשר … לא נתכוון זה אלא להַפְלִיגָהּ</he> whenever an impossibility is made the condition of a letter of divorce, he (the husband) has had only the intention to divert her mind; Y. B. Mets. VII, end, 11ᶜ (corr. acc.). Y. Ber. IX, end, 14ᵈ <he>כיון שה׳ דעתו ממנה</he> when he turns his attentions from her (makes her feel that he does not intend to marry her).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17">Gen. R. s. 17</cite> <he>ראה … והִפְלִיגָהּ ממנו</he> when he saw her full mucus and blood, he kept her away from him; a. fr.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 31:1">Pesik. R. s. 31</cite> <he>היתה פושעת … ומַפְלֶגֶת את גזירותיו</he> she was careless about his honor and disregarded his decrees.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 3">Ib. s. 3</cite> [read:] <he>כל זמן … הוא מַפְלִיג וכ׳</he> as long as his teacher is alive, he (the pupil) is careless, (saying) whenever it be needed, here is my teacher &c.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:3">Ab. IV, 3</cite> <he>אל תהי מפליג לכל דבר</he> discard nothing (saying, this will never happen).
Gen. R. s. 8 ה׳ דרכן של רשעים וכ׳ he removed the way of the wicked out of his sight (disregarded the evil doings of the future man); Midr. Till. to Ps. I ed. Bub. (oth. ed. פִּילֵּג Pi.); a. e.

Gen. R. s. 48 אם אני רואה אותן שהִפְלִיגוּ את דרכם וכ׳ when I see that they wend their way hither &c.; וכיון שראה אותם שהפליגו and when he saw that they were declining; Yalk. ib. 82.—Trnsf. to be mistaken.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 43b:18">Bekh. 43ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>הִיפְלַגְתָּ</he> thou art mistaken (Rashi: thou hast gone too far, v. infra); Sifra Emor, ch. II, Par. 3 <he>הִפְלַגְתָּה</he>.—
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 11:9:1">Koh. R. to XI, 9</cite> <he>אל תַּפְלִיג עצמך בדברי תורה</he> do not go thy own way in the interpretation of the Law (cling to tradition).

senses.gloss: ה׳ עצמו [to withdraw one’s self,] to be reserved, speak in indefinite and general terms, opp. פרסם עצמו to reveal one’s self, speak in definite terms. Midr. Sam. ch. XIV (ref. to I Sam. IX, 15, sq.) לשעבר לא אלא עד שלא הגיע הקץ הקב״ה מפליג עצמו … מפרסם עצמו did the Lord never before reveal anything to Samuel? But before the proper time has come, the Lord speaks reservedly, when the time has come, he reveals himself clearly (‘to-morrow’ &c.)

units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 320:1">Yalk. Jer. 320</cite> <he>מי שמפליג על דבריו של אל</he> who opposes the words of God. Y. Pes. V, 32ᶜ bot. <he>ומה מַפְלִיגִין</he> and wherein do they differ?; a. e.

senses.gloss: to go too far. Y. Nidd. I, beg. 48ᵈ, v. פָּרַז.
units: Bekh. 43ᵇ bot.; Sifra Emor l. c., v. supra.—Part. pass. מוּפְלָג
